summary: SM2 is the second of up to four connected 300 mm analog and embedded processing fabs on Texas Instruments' Sherman, Texas site. TI planned to start building its first two Sherman fabs in 2022 and broke ground on the site that May. By June 2025 TI reported the SM2 exterior shell complete; no production date has been given. The fab shares a December 2024 CHIPS award with SM1.
